checks.text: Step 1: Layla gives Ahmed a Trade DCL does not have: rejected (a Member never covers more than the Participant)
Step 2: Saeed narrowing DCL off Electrical while Mohammed holds an Electrical MAR is refused (a Handover is needed first)
The refusal names no Step, item, Member or Document Number of DCL
The answer gives a count only (like: 1 Step of DCL needs a new holder first)

notes: Step 3 second half not run: narrowing DCL's Locations from all to Tower 1 and widening back needs DCL to hold no Tower 2 Step, which other UAT cases keep open, and widening would leave every DCL engineer narrowed for the other Parts. The refusal above is proven. A person checks on a clean seed: 1) Saeed narrows DCL to Tower 1 only, then widens DCL back to all. 2) Open Ahmed's Visibility.
